policy: Exact positional extents recovered from actual blind English corpus. Every page has identical primary/independent word counts; all global edits are one-to-one. Unit boundaries match frozen primary exactly. Prayed Biblical quotes misclassified as citation by reader remain prayer; printed numbered references and linkage cues excluded. No candidate is manufactured from final text.

ahavah_rabbah.primary: With great love hast Thou loved us, O Lord our God, great and abundant compassion hast Thou shown us. Our Father, our King, for the sake of our fathers who trusted in Thee and whom Thou didst teach the statutes of life, likewise be gracious to us and teach us. Our Father, merciful and compassionate Father, have compassion upon us and set it in our heart to comprehend and to understand, to hear, to learn and to teach, to keep, perform and fulfil all words of the teaching of Thy Torah in love. Enlighten our eyes through Thy Torah, attach our heart to Thy commandments, consecrate our heart to love Thy Name and to fear it, so that never may we be disgraced. For in Thy great and awe-inspiring Name do we trust, we exult and rejoice in Thy help. Bring us in peace from the four corners of the earth and lead us upright into our land. For Thou art God who creates salvation and Thou hast chosen us from all peoples and tongues and brought us near Thy great Name for ever in truth, to thank Thee and to proclaim Thy unity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has chosen His people Israel in love.

shacharit_deuteronomy_6_5_to_9.primary: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your possession. These words which I command you this day, shall be upon your heart. You shall inculcate them in your children and speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall bind them for a sign upon your arm and they shall be frontlets between your eyes. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates.

shacharit_deuteronomy_11_13_to_21.primary: And it shall happen if you listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul, that I will grant the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, so that you will gather in your corn, your wine and your oil. I will give grass to your field for your cattle, and you shall eat and be satisfied. Take care that your heart be not deceived and that you do not turn aside and serve strange gods and bow down before them. For then the wrath of the Lord will burn against you and He will close the heavens so that no rain shall fall and the earth shall not yield its produce, and you shall soon perish from the good land that the Lord is giving you. Lay these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, bind them as a sign upon your arm and let them be frontlets between your eyes. Teach them to your children by talking about them when you sit in your house and walk on the way and when you lie down and when you rise up. You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates, so that your days and the days of your children may increase upon the soil which the Lord has sworn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

shacharit_numbers_15_37_to_41.primary: Thus spoke the Lord to Moses: Speak to the children of Israel and tell them to make themselves show-fringes upon the corners of their garments throughout their generations and to fasten to the fringe of each corner a thread of skyblue wool. They shall be show-fringes to you so that when you look upon them, you will remember all the commandments of the Lord and fulfil them. And do not follow your heart and your eyes after which you go astray. Thus may you remember and fulfil all my commandments and be holy unto your God. I am the Lord your God who led you out of the land of Egypt in order to be your God. I am the Lord your God.

emet_veyatziv.primary: True and firm and established and everlasting and upright and faithful and pleasant and precious and delightful and glorious and awe-inspiring and powerful and ordered and favoured and good and comely is this word for us for ever and ever. In truth He is the God of the world, our King, the Rock of Jacob, the shield of our salvation. From generation to generation does He endure and His Name endures, His throne is firmly founded and His realm and His faithfulness endure for ever. And His words are living and eternal, faithful and delightful always and in all eternity for our fathers and for us, for our children and our coming generations and all the generations of the seed of Israel Thy servants. For the first and the last it is a good and everlasting word, truth and faithfulness, a statute that never passes away. It is truth that Thou, O Lord, art our God and the God of our fathers, our King, the King of our fathers, our Redeemer, the Redeemer of our fathers, our Creator, the Rock of our salvation, our deliverer and rescuer, that is Thy Name since eternity, there is no God except Thee. The aid of our fathers hast Thou ever been, shield and helper of their children after them in every generation. In the heights of the world is Thy dwelling and Thy judgments and Thy love extend to the ends of the earth. Fortunate the man, who listens to Thy commandments and takes Thy Torah and Thy word to heart. In truth Thou art the Lord for Thy people and a strong King to promote their cause. In truth Thou art the first and Thou art the last and except for Thee we have no King, Redeemer or helper. From Egypt hast Thou redeemed us, O Lord our God, and from the house of slaves hast Thou freed us. All their first born hast Thou slain and Thy first born redeemed, divided the Sea of Reeds, drowned the arrogant and led those dear to Thee through to safety. Then the waters covered their enemies, not one of them remained. Thereupon those who were loved, sang and praised God and those dear to Him offered hymns of praise, songs and glorification, blessings and thanks to the King, the living, eternal God. Lofty and exalted, great and awe-inspiring, He lowers the proud, raises the lowly, leads prisoners to freedom, redeems the meek, helps the poor and hears His people at the time when they implore Him. Praises to the supreme God, blessed is He and called blessed.  Moses and the children of Israel intoned a song to Thee with great rejoicing and all of them said: Who is like Thee among the powers, O Lord, who is like Thee, glorified in holiness, awe-inspiring in fame, worker of wonders. The redeemed sang a new song in praise of Thy Name at the edge of the sea, together they all gave thanks and paid homage and said:  the Lord reigns for ever and ever. Rock of Israel, rise to the help of Israel and redeem according to Thine utterance Judah and Israel. Our Redeemer, the Lord of Hosts is His Name, the Holy One of Israel. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has redeemed Israel.

shacharit_amidah_avot.primary: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, the great, mighty and awe-inspiring God, God the Most High, who performs acts of kindness and owns everything and remembers the good deeds of the fathers and will bring a redeemer for their children’s children for His Name’s sake in love. Remember us for life, O King who delights in life, and inscribe us in the book of life for Thy sake, O living God. O King, helper and saviour and shield, blessed art Thou, O Lord, the shield of Abraham.

shacharit_amidah_gevurot.primary: Thou art for ever mighty, O Lord the reviver of the dead, Thou art great to save. Sustaining life with kindness, reviving the dead with great compassion, supporting the falling and healing the sick and releasing captives and keeping His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like Thee, Master of might, and who resembles Thee, O King, who slays and revives and causes salvation to spring forth. Who is like Thee, Father of compassion, who remembers His creatures for life in compassion. And Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who revives the dead.

shacharit_amidah_qedushat_hashem.primary: Thou art holy and Thy Name is holy and holy ones praise Thee every day. Selah! And therefore put the fear of Thee, O Lord our God, upon all Thy works and awe of Thee upon all that Thou hast created, so that all works may fear Thee and all the created bow down before Thee and all of them may be made into one group for the performance of Thy will with a complete heart, since we know, O Lord our God, that dominion lies before Thee, that strength is in Thy hand and might in Thy right hand and that Thy Name inspires with awe all that Thou has created. And therefore grant honour, O Lord, to Thy people, fame to those who fear Thee and praise to those who seek Thee and confidence to those who wait for Thee, joy to Thy land happiness to Thy city and a rise of fortune to David Thy servant and an array of light to the son of Jesse Thine anointed speedily and in our days. And thus may the righteous see and rejoice and the upright exult and the pious revel with joy. Vice shall close its mouth and all evil entirely disappear like smoke when Thou removest the dominion of arrogance from the earth. And Thou, O Lord, shalt reign alone over all Thy works on Mount Zion, Thy glorious dwelling, and in Jerusalem, Thy Holy City, as it is written in Thy holy word, the Lord shall reign for ever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah! Holy art Thou and awe-inspiring is Thy Name and there is no God beside Thee, as it is written, exalted is the Lord of Hosts through judgment and the Holy God is sanctified through righteousness. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, the Holy King.

shacharit_amidah_qedushat_hayom.primary: Thou hast chosen us from all peoples, loved us and found delight in us and exalted us above all tongues and sanctified us through Thy commandments, and brought us near, O our King, to Thy service and proclaimed Thy great and holy Name unto us. Thou hast given us, O Lord our God, in love this day (of the Sabbath and this day) of remembrance, a day (of remembrance) of Teruah (in love) for a sacred convocation, a reminder of the exodus from Egypt. Our God and God of our fathers, may there rise and come and arrive and appear and be favourably received and be heard and considered and remain in memory before Thee, our remembrance and our consideration and the memory of our fathers and the memory of the anointed, the son of David, Thy servant, and the memory of Jerusalem the Holy City, and the memory of all Thy people, the House of Israel, for deliverance and for happiness, for favour and for grace and for compassion, for life and for peace on this Day of Remembrance. Remember us, O Lord our God, on it for happiness, consider us on it for blessing and help us on it unto life, and through the word of salvation and compassion, spare us and be gracious unto us have compassion upon us, and help us, for towards Thee our eyes are turned, for Thou O God, art a gracious and merciful King. Our God and God of our fathers, reign over the whole world in Thy glory and rise above the whole earth in Thy grandeur. Shine forth in the exalted beauty of Thy might upon all the inhabitants of the territory of Thine earth so that every creature may recognize that Thou hast created it and that every form may understand that Thou hast formed it and all with breath in the nostrils may say: The Lord, the God of Israel, is King and His Kingdom rules over all. (Our God and God of our fathers, take pleasure in our rest.) Sanctify us through Thy commandments and grant our portion in Thy Torah, satisfy us with Thy goodness and gladden us with Thy help (and grant us, O Lord our God, in love and favour, Thy holy Sabbath as a portion so that Israel, who sanctifies Thy Name, may rest on it) and purify our heart to serve Thee in truth for Thou, O Lord, art truth and Thy word is truth and endures for ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord King over the whole earth, who sanctifies (the Sabbath and) Israel and the Day of Remembrance.

Remember us, O Lord our God, on it for happiness, consider us on it for blessing and help us on it unto life, and through the word of salvation and compassion, spare us and be gracious unto us have compassion upon us, and help us, for towards Thee our eyes are turned, for Thou O God, art a gracious and merciful King. Our God and God of our fathers, reign over the whole world in Thy glory and rise above the whole earth in Thy grandeur. Shine forth in the exalted beauty of Thy might upon all the inhabitants of the territory of Thine earth so that every creature may recognize that Thou hast created it and that every form may understand that Thou hast formed it and all with breath in the nostrils may say: The Lord, the God of Israel, is King and His Kingdom rules over all. shacharit_amidah_avodah.primary: Take delight, O Lord our God, in Thy people Israel and in their prayer and restore the service to the sanctuary of Thy House and accept with love and favour the fire offerings of Israel and their prayer, and may the service of Thy people Israel be a perpetual delight. And may our eyes behold when Thou returnest to Zion in compassion. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who restores His majesty to Zion.

shacharit_amidah_hodaah.primary: We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand and for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy kindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee. For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever. And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant. And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid. Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.

shacharit_amidah_sim_shalom.primary: Bestow peace, good fortune, blessing, favour, grace and compassion upon us and upon all Israel Thy people. Bless us, our Father, all of us together through the light of Thy countenance, for through the light of Thy countenance hast Thou given us, O Lord our God, the Torah of life and gracious love, salvation and blessing, mercy, life and peace; and it is good in Thine eyes to bless Thy people Israel at every time and in every hour with Thy peace. In the book of life, blessing, peace and a good livelihood, may we be remembered and inscribed before Thee, we and all Thy people the house of Israel for a good life and for peace. Blessed art Thou, O Lord who makes peace.

shacharit_elohai_netzor.primary: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking falsehood. Towards those who curse me, let my soul be silent and let my soul be as dust in relation to everything. Open my heart to Thy Torah and let my soul pursue Thy commandments and as for all those that devise evil against me, speedily frustrate their counsel and upset their plan. Do this for the sake of Thy Name, do this for the sake of Thy right hand, do this for the sake of Thy holiness, do this for the sake of Thy Torah so that those who love Thee may be delivered. Save with Thy right hand and respond to me. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart find favour before Thee, O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer. May He who makes peace in His heights, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.

shacharit_yehi_ratzon_temple.primary: May it find favour before Thee, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, that the sanctuary be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant our portion in Thy Torah. There we will serve Thee in awe as in the days of old and former years. And pleasant unto the Lord shall be the offering of Judah and Jerusalem as in the days of old and former years.
